name: essentials
description: Trustworks Essentials Java/Kotlin framework support: a vertical-slice law (command, view, automation, translation; R1-R5 anti-god-class rules) with commands to scaffold, audit, discover, map and enrich slices, in the terminal and as the Slice Atlas; an application stack contract (S1-S11) with Kotlin/Java bindings, a frontend spec and version pins; docs and change-routing skills; init and upgrade to create a verified project and keep it current; review against the traps; and doctor for the tools.
